_comment: v1.11.0 follow-up 2 - carry the same bold subsection numbers into the English and Italian translations, so section 4 of the Latin can be lined up against section 4 of each translation. The Latin is already marked (batch/marks1110.json) and mark_sections.js skips a field that carries markers, so re-running this spec touches only `english` and `italian`. Translation anchors CANNOT be derived from a numbered edition - only a person can say where a translation turns the corner the Latin turns - so every one below is written by hand and checked against the Latin section it opens. Note the two places where a section starts mid-sentence and the marker therefore lands inside a clause: DBG VIII praef. 5 (Latin `superetur: qui sunt editi`) and Bellum Alexandrinum 1.5 (`excluderet, illud spectans primum`).

(De Bello Gallico VI.13).author: gaius-julius-caesar
english: In all of Gaul, among those men
Most of them, pressed down by debt

The druids take part in divine matters
For they decide on almost all public
if any private person or community does not abide

(De Bello Gallico VI.14).author: gaius-julius-caesar
